summary: The mobile layout has visual overlap issues where the open dropdown menu obstructs underlying summary content, along with minor chart axis clipping and an empty header container.

issues.title: Menu overlaps summary card
issues.description: The dropdown menu covers critical incident details on mobile viewports.
issues.evidence: The menu overlays the top incident card, obscuring description text.
issues.suggestion: Display the menu as a bottom sheet on small viewports.

issues.title: X-axis label clipped
issues.description: Leftmost x-axis timestamp label is clipped at container edge.
issues.evidence: The initial '00' label on the chart axis is cut off on its left edge.
issues.suggestion: Increase chart container left padding or adjust axis margin.

issues.title: Empty header container
issues.description: An empty pill element appears in the upper right header.
issues.evidence: A hollow rounded rectangle outline is rendered in the top-right corner.
issues.suggestion: Remove the empty element or supply its intended trigger icon.
